subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` check threshold for secrets-audit automation?
rationale: The implementation is clean and default-compatible, but deciding whether info-level secrets-audit findings may be ignored by CI/operator gates is a security/product policy decision for a secops-owned surface.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR now and invite a secops/CLI owner to sponsor or reopen the threshold if the policy is accepted.

options.title: Sponsor Current Flag
options.body: Accept the new public CLI contract as opt-in because plain `--check` remains default-compatible and the PR has proof, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Request Narrower Policy
options.body: Ask for a narrower owner-approved variant, such as limiting the threshold to selected finding classes or folding it into a broader secrets audit cleanup design.
